english.title: Use threatening / abusive words / behaviour likely to cause harassment, alarm or distress
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used threatening or abusive words or behaviour or disorderly behaviour within the hearing or sight of a person likely to be caused harassment, alarm or distress thereby
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1) and (6) of the Public Order Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

(i) This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - PND Code DA04 .
(ii) See offence wording H351 for the similar offence under section 4A of intentional harassment/alarm/distress.
(iii) See also offence wording: H11413.
(iv) See the CPS charging standards for this offence before preparing any charges.
(v) This offence is a recordable offence, despite not being an imprisonable offence, see the Schedule to the National Police Records (Recordable Offences) Regulations 2000, therefore actions regarding DNA samples, fingerprints and photographs apply.
(vi) From 1st May 2023, this offence is no longer notifiable to the Home Office. The aggravated offence at PNLD H2808 remains notifiable.
